loadRemoteNotesFailed: Failed to load remote notes. Check the target connection settings.
targetTokenSecret1Description: Store the API token under Settings → Secrets and variables, then enter the secret name here
targetTokenSecret2Description: Store the API token under Settings → Secrets and variables, then enter the secret name here
validateConnectionDescription: Check the target version, authentication, and notebook read access
transferAllDescription: Export all local data into an empty or disposable target workspace
pullAllDescription: Import all target data into the local workspace for a one-time migration
enableLoggingDescription: Reserved setting for diagnostic console output
preserveIdsDescription: For related workspace clones only; requires matching versions and notebook IDs and rejects documents containing attribute views
allowInsecureHttpDescription: Enable only on a trusted LAN; HTTP exposes API tokens, notes, and workspace archives in transit
configureTargetFirst: Configure the target server URL first
connectionFailed: Failed to connect to the target server
legacyTokenWarning: A legacy plaintext token was found. Create a Secret under SiYuan Settings → Secrets and variables and enter its name in the plugin settings. The old value is removed after successful validation.
transferFailedPartial: Full transfer failed; the destination may contain partially imported data
pullFailedPartial: Full pull failed; the local workspace may contain partially imported data
fullTransferWarning: A full transfer imports all local data into the target workspace and may overwrite or mix existing data. Confirm matching SiYuan versions, backups, and an empty or disposable destination. Continue?
fullPullWarning: A full pull imports all target data into this local workspace and may overwrite or mix existing data. Confirm matching SiYuan versions, backups, and that this workspace is disposable for the migration. Continue?
safeTransferScopeWarning: Safe transfer uses SiYuan's native export. The archive may include referenced documents, child documents (depending on source export settings), related attribute views, and supporting assets in addition to your selection. Continue?
preserveTransferWarning: Expert mode overwrites selected destination documents with matching IDs. Existing unselected ancestors are retained and asset conflicts abort before writing. Confirm related workspaces, matching versions, and backups. Continue?
fileTreeReloadWarning: Data was imported, but the file tree could not refresh automatically; refresh or restart SiYuan manually
